findings.title: An unchanged claim owner can still consume after new request/attempt evidence
findings.rootCause: Candidate fingerprint binds static Queue identity but not its actual minted postclaim attempt/lease/error/request metadata. At consume, the current row guard only rejects nonzero attempt_count, failureCategory outside null/DEPENDENCY, or exact INTERRUPTED message. last_request_id/last_error_code/first_failed_at are not checked and last_attempt_at need not equal the time belonging to this claim. CAS compares freshly reread last_attempt_at/updated_at rather than a claim-mint commitment, so evidence changed before that read is accepted.
findings.minimalReproduction: After a genuine candidate claim, retain its owner/status/count/category and original BLOCKED intent; UPDATE only last_request_id to review-known-attempt and last_attempt_at to2026-10-12T00:00:01Z. Existing null receipt transport is used. Expected RECEIPT_ONLY with zero submit; actual RECEIPT/FULL/APPLIED from submit. Actual node:sqlite and existing canonical Core command fixture; not a real UNKNOWN/Hosted operation.
findings.requiredDelta: Bind the existing claim-context fingerprint to the exact actual postclaim attempt/lease/lastAttempt/error/request metadata created by the successful claim, then rederive that binding from the current PROCESSING row at consume. Any subsequent request/attempt/uncertainty drift must stay receipt-only even when the opaque owner, count0 and accepted graph remain unchanged. Alternatively an equally small exact anchored preimage check is acceptable if it cannot be rebuilt from changed current metadata. Include relevant fields in consume CAS too. Preserve legitimate already-existing dependency metadata exactly; do not blanket erase it, reset IN_FLIGHT, add a column/table/permit, alter Native/Queue globally or block original receipt recovery.
findings.scopeLimit: This is a proven local negative-state gap, not a claim that Hosted/Native CORRECT is activated or that another legal caller currently produces this exact drift combination. Native adapters remain missing/default closed; implementation must preserve the stronger stated current-uncertainty invariant before activation.
findings.focusedAcceptance: Retain original29. One same-owner postclaim attempt/request drift case must become RECEIPT_ONLY without modifying original intent/accepted graph; receipt-present recovery still works. Reuse normal untouched same-claim control to ensure exactly one handoff remains.
